summary: Valaris Ltd files an 8-K reporting that CFIUS clearance has been obtained for Transocean Ltd's acquisition of Valaris. Under the Business Combination Agreement dated February 9, 2026, Valaris shareholders will receive 15.235 Transocean shares per Valaris share. The deal is still subject to HSR Act clearance; a Second Request from the DOJ has been received, and the parties have agreed not to close until at least 60 days after certifying substantial compliance, expected no earlier than late September 2026. Closing remains targeted for H2 2026. The key risk-arb factor is the regulatory timeline from the DOJ Second Request.
